🇺🇸🇳🇬 End of December US fired 12 Tomahawk missiles in Nigeria at ISIS.

Today another unexplored warhead was discovered in Nigeria, what brings the total to 4.

Out of 12 tomahawks 4 did not reach their target and did not explode.

25% failure rate by itself? https://t.co/GnP1Sa8JQu

description.description: A collage of four different photographs showing large, unexploded aerial bombs or munitions. The top-left image shows a bomb lying on a textured surface, possibly a road or pavement. The top-right image captures a bomb partially buried in red soil, focused on the fuse assembly and metal casing. The bottom-left photo shows a similar munition lying in a brushy, outdoor area. The bottom-right image shows a bomb mostly buried in a trench of red dirt with a person holding a smartphone visible in the foreground.
